method: Scanned every normalized heading component and cross-reference target for digit-in-word substitutions, diacritic loss, mojibake, replacement characters, apostrophe/quote/dash/prime corruption, normalization form, foreign-script homoglyphs, ligature variants, capitalization, and plausible split/merge/duplication/omission patterns.
Scanned every displayed locator for numeric-range punctuation and preserved all atomic locator mappings and source-grounded judgments.
Compared suspected spellings with the exact-edition OUP publisher preview first, then the supplied same-edition body, official authority sources, and systemic orthographic inference.
Re-resolved all sixteen cross-references after eligible corrections.
Rejected an accent-only correction for Antraigues/Emile because authoritative name evidence points to a larger possible name-form difference and the OUP leaf is unavailable.

legitimate_non_corruption_record.disposition: legitimate ordinal; not a character substitution

negative_findings.unicode_normalization_differences: none; all reviewed strings are NFC
negative_findings.confirmed_additional_split_merged_or_dup: none beyond the ledgered Brienne and uncertain Antraigues cases

authoritative_evidence.preview_limit: Selected OUP index leaves are omitted; uncertainty is retained or explicitly resolved only in the publisher-favorable estimate.
